resources.string: Send arbitrary raw PB through the current account IM SDK; inspect and save responses.
Enter cmd, inboxType and raw PB. Send a complete RequestBody directly, or wrap business PB with an explicit bodyTag. The host supplies authentication. Only Send submits a request.
The account changed. Close and reopen the sender.
The sender is not running. Turn its switch on, restart Douyin and check the feature status page.
RequestBody field number bodyTag (independent of cmd)
Raw bytes in the selected Hex / Base64 encoding; empty PB is allowed
Full PB loaded: %1$d bytes. Clear to edit again.
The editor accepts 65536 characters. Use Load clipboard for larger PB, up to 4 MiB.
RequestBody to send: %1$d bytes (first 256 bytes previewed below)
Each click submits once; response timeout is 30 seconds. Closing stops local waiting and cannot undo a submitted request.
Preview shows the first 4096 bytes. A response does not imply business success. Save the full PB for responses over 64 KiB.
cmd must be a positive integer.
inboxType must be a nonnegative integer.
Hex must contain pairs of hexadecimal characters, with optional whitespace.
The wrapped RequestBody must not exceed 4 MiB.
No Douyin account is signed in, so nothing can be sent.
